note: A thing out of a barrow, and the other argument a sword does not settle. Its missing hit points are in properties/monsters.json rather than here, and they are what makes a blade pass through it without a line of code anywhere saying so.
The numbers here are a shape, and a shape is read by looking at it rather than by being told.

parts.note: No legs at all: a hem that narrows away to nothing above the grass. That absence is the tell from any distance, and it is why the walk cycle has nothing to swing down there.
Two cold lights where a face is not.
